data.narrative:
Scale AI, a Series B AI & Software company, is evaluated against a peer universe of 6 private companies at same or adjacent stages, including Figure AI ($39.0B Series C), Reflection AI ($25.0B Series A), Skild AI ($14.0B Series C), Crusoe Energy ($10.0B Series C), and Physical Intelligence ($5.6B Series B). The peer set spans a $3.2B–$39.0B range.

Two valuation methods triangulate the fair value. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the last post-money valuation of $29.0B, yielding $55.1B. Peer-median benchmarking across the 6-company sample produces a median valuation of $12.0B, reflecting material dispersion in the cohort. The current reported valuation of $29.0B sits between these two approaches but notably above the peer median, suggesting either founder premium, proprietary competitive position, or market exuberance relative to comparable companies.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $10.2B (low) to $63.4B (high), with a median of $33.5B. The wide range reflects substantive uncertainty: the peer-median method anchors conservatively, while stage-progression suggests meaningful upside. Key unknowns include Scale AI's unit economics relative to peers, revenue growth trajectory, and whether the $29.0B current valuation reflects market consensus or outlier financing terms. Further diligence on capital efficiency and go-to-market execution would narrow this band.
